# Dark Funnel — map the buyer journey your attribution can't see

Curated by Skill Harbor — @indranilbanerjee's dark-funnel skill, listed here with credit to its creator (part of the digital-marketing-pro plugin collection): illuminate the "dark funnel" — the buyer-journey activity your attribution platform can't see. The agent aggregates dark signals (branded search volume trends, Reddit/community mention frequency and sentiment, AI chatbot citations via the sibling geo-monitor, podcast attribution data, direct-traffic anomalies, "how did you hear about us" survey responses), correlates signal spikes against a timeline of known marketing activities (with lag times), maps each untracked touchpoint to a buyer-journey stage with estimated reach, scores every channel on signal strength, growth trend, sentiment, and conversion proximity, and produces a prioritized investment plan plus an ongoing monitoring cadence. Honest caveats: this is analysis, not data collection — you need real inputs (brand name, community presence, podcast history, GA4/Search Console access, survey data) or the report is guesswork; it reads a brand profile at ~/.claude-marketing/brands/ and pairs with the digital-marketing-pro brand-setup skill; treat the "influence estimation" as directional triangulation, not accounting. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
